name: Mixture of Neural Implicit Functions
aliases: Generative Neural Fields by Mixtures of Neural Implicit Functions
Generative Neural Fields with a Mixture of Neural Implicit Functions
definition: A generative neural field approach based on a mixture of neural implicit functions. The modulation scheme allows increasing model capacity by learning more neural basis functions while keeping inference compact via weighted model averaging.
summary: Mixture of Neural Implicit Functions represents data as a weighted sum of basis networks, offering a stable, flexible modulation scheme that separates shared structure from instance-specific details.
